question: If the tapped creature used for station has negative power, are any charge counters put on the permanent with station?

expected.shortAnswer: No: if the tapped creature has negative power, no charge counters are put on or removed from it.
expected.answer: If the tapped creature has negative power, no charge counters are put onto or removed from the permanent with station.
